+ अङ्ग रथ- + अङ्ग,
 I. n. 1. any part of a carriage. 2. a wheel.
 II. m. the ruddy goose, Anas casarca.
रथाङ्ग, i. e. रथ-अङ्ग- (= चक्र), m. a name of Viṣṇu.
+ ईशा रथ- + ईशा, f. the pole of a car,
+ उत्तम रथ- + उत्तम, m. an excellent cart,
Bhag. 1, 24
+ उपस्थ रथ- + उपस्थ, m. and n. the carioteer's seat for driving.
+ कुटुम्बिन् रथ- + कुटुम्बिन्, m. a charioteer,
+ गुप्ति रथ- + गुप्ति, f. an apparatus encompassing a war-chariot, to secure it from being injured by weapons or collision.
रथ-चर्या, f. a chariot-exercise.
+ ज्वर रथ- + ज्वर, m. a crow.
रथ-अङ्ग-श्रोणि-विम्ब, adj., f. बा, having buttocks [] like the part (half) of a wheel, i. e. semicircular, Vikr. d. 100.

रथ (vb. ऋ), m.
 1. A car, Hit. pr. d. 32, M.M.; a war chariot,

. Any vehicle.
 3. A [] limb.
 4. A foot.
 5. The body.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. rota; A.S. and O.H.G. rad (probably borrowed); probably ῥέθος; Goth. lithus; A.S. lidh.
रथकट्या, i. e. रथ-कट + य (cf. कट and निकट), f. A multitude of cars.
रथ-कर, m. A carpenter.

रथ-कार, m.
 1. A carpenter, Pañc. 229, 8.
 2. A man sprung from a male of the माहिष्य and a female of the करणी caste, by profession a coach-maker.
रथकार + त्व, n. The business of a carpenter, Pañc. 228, 12.
रथ-गर्भ + क, m. A car or litter borne on men's shoulders.
रथ-तुर्, adj. Overpowering, i. e. drawing, the carriage,
रथधूर्गत, i. e. रथ-धुर्-गत (vb. गम्), adj. Gone upon the pole of the chariot, Johns.
रथारथि, i. e. रथ-रथ + इ, adv. In mutual contact of the chariots, i. e. in closest fight,
रथिक, i. e. रथ + इक, m. The owner of, or rider in, a car.

रथिन्, i. e. रथ + ईन्,
 I. adj. Mounted on carriages,

.
 II. m.
 1. The owner of, or rider in, a car, lord of chariots, Vikr. d. 100.
 2. A warrior who fights in a car,
Draup. 2, 12
; Utt.
Rāmac. 130, 4

.
 --Comp.
रथिन, and रथिर रथिर i. e. रथ + इन् + अ, and with र् for न्, m. The owner of, or rider in, a car.

रथ्य, i. e. रथ + य,
 I. m. A carriage horse.
 II. f. या.
 1. A multitude of cars,
Rājat. 5, 241

(warriors?).
 2. A high street.
 3. A place where several roads meet.
 III. n. A wheel.
+ वाहक रथ- + वाहक, m. the driver of a carriage,
+ शाला रथ- + शाला, f. a coach-house,
